related.title: Raft：日誌衝突與已提交前綴
related.titleEn: Raft: log conflicts and committed prefixes
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：枚舉五節點所有三節點集合，證明任何兩個多數集合至少交一節點。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Enumerate all three-of-five quorums and show any two share at least one node. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 用 index/term 表追蹤 follower 與 leader 的衝突位置，修復未提交尾端。
related.differenceEn: Trace index/term conflicts between follower and leader and repair an uncommitted suffix.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 多數交集是共識安全論證的一部分；還需任期、投票與日誌新舊限制，不是單憑投票數即可。 教學基準：floor(5/2)+1 = 3 majority size；第二檢核：3+3-5 = 1 minimum overlap。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

AppendEntries 以 prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm 檢查前綴；不能任意刪除已提交項目。 教學基準：4-2 = 2 conflicting follower suffix entries；第二檢核：5-2 = 3 leader suffix entries to append。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Majority intersection supports consensus safety but term,voting and log-freshness rules are also required. Teaching baseline: floor(5/2)+1 = 3 majority size; second check: 3+3-5 = 1 minimum overlap. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

AppendEntries checks prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm; committed entries must not be arbitrarily removed. Teaching baseline: 4-2 = 2 conflicting follower suffix entries; second check: 5-2 = 3 leader suffix entries to append. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Apache Flink：event time、watermark 與遲到資料
related.titleEn: Apache Flink: event time,watermarks and late data
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：枚舉五節點所有三節點集合，證明任何兩個多數集合至少交一節點。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Enumerate all three-of-five quorums and show any two share at least one node. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 以亂序事件建立 tumbling window，追蹤 watermark 如何界定完成與遲到。
related.differenceEn: Build tumbling windows from out-of-order events and trace completion and lateness via watermarks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 多數交集是共識安全論證的一部分；還需任期、投票與日誌新舊限制，不是單憑投票數即可。 教學基準：floor(5/2)+1 = 3 majority size；第二檢核：3+3-5 = 1 minimum overlap。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Watermark 是來源對 event-time 進度的宣告，非證明永遠不會有更舊資料；遲到處置需明訂。 教學基準：13-3 = 10 watermark after event 13；第二檢核：floor(13/10)*10 = 10 event-13 window start。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Majority intersection supports consensus safety but term,voting and log-freshness rules are also required. Teaching baseline: floor(5/2)+1 = 3 majority size; second check: 3+3-5 = 1 minimum overlap. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

A watermark is a source progress declaration,not proof that older events can never arrive; late-data handling is explicit. Teaching baseline: 13-3 = 10 watermark after event 13; second check: floor(13/10)*10 = 10 event-13 window start. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
